tasks.label: clxrity-img: link global executable
tasks.command: pnpm build && npm prefix -g && npm link --ignore-scripts && zsh -lic 'rehash; command -v clxrity-img && clxrity-img --version && clxrity-img --help'

tasks.label: clxrity-img: verify global command
tasks.command: zsh -lic 'cd /tmp && rehash && command -v clxrity-img && clxrity-img --version && clxrity-img --help'

tasks.label: clxrity-img: diagnose global command
tasks.command:
printf '
Current shell:
'; command -v node; command -v pnpm; command -v clxrity-img || true; printf '
Global bin directory:
'; pnpm bin -g; printf '
Installed global packages:
'; pnpm list -g --depth 0; printf '
Fresh interactive zsh:
'; zsh -lic 'command -v pnpm; command -v clxrity-img || true; printf "PNPM_HOME=%s
" "$PNPM_HOME"; pnpm bin -g'

tasks.label: clxrity-img: audit (no pager)
tasks.command: git --no-pager -c core.excludesFile=/dev/null status --short --branch && git --no-pager -c core.excludesFile=/dev/null diff --check && git --no-pager -c core.excludesFile=/dev/null check-ignore .env .env.example pnpm-lock.yaml

tasks.label: clxrity-img: check Node 24
tasks.command: pnpm check && pnpm --package=node@24 dlx node --version && pnpm --package=node@24 dlx node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
